NFL DFS Wide Receiver Rankings: Week 7 (DraftKings)

DraftKings main slate · Sunday, October 25 · 10 games · By Chris Spags · · Numbers as of October 25, 12:41 PM ET

Puka Nacua is the top-projected wide receiver on the Week 7 DraftKings main slate at 20.8 DraftKings points for $8,400, at Las Vegas. Amon-Ra St. Brown (19.9, $7,800) and Drake London (18.1, $7,500) are next.

Matthew Golden returns the most per dollar among wide receivers projected for at least 9 points: 2.75 projected points per $1,000 at $6,000.

Every projection is a SPAGS model estimate from the October 25, 12:41 PM ET run of the Splash Play NFL model. This page updates each time the main-slate numbers are published.

Wide receivers to know in Week 7

Puka Nacua, LAR at LV ($8,400)

Puka Nacua carries the highest SPAGS model projection at the position, 20.8 DraftKings points at $8,400, the 5th-highest on the entire main slate. That is 1.0 points clear of Amon-Ra St. Brown. The model gives him 11.6 targets on 33.3 routes. The salary works out to 2.48 projected points per $1,000, 4th of 28 at the position. Across 100,000 simulations Nacua averaged 20.8 points with a simulated floor of 8.1 and a ceiling of 45.4, and he holds 15% of the simulated winning-lineup credit. The Rams are a 3.5-point favorite on the road against Las Vegas, with an implied team total of 26 in a game totaled at 48.5.

Amon-Ra St. Brown, DET vs GB ($7,800)

Amon-Ra St. Brown projects 2nd at the position with 19.9 DraftKings points at $7,800. The model gives him 9.9 targets on 34.2 routes. The salary works out to 2.55 projected points per $1,000, 3rd of 28 at the position. Across 100,000 simulations Brown averaged 19.9 points with a simulated floor of 6.6 and a ceiling of 44.4, and he holds 18% of the simulated winning-lineup credit. Detroit is a 3.5-point favorite at home against Green Bay, with an implied team total of 29.5 in a game totaled at 55.5.

Drake London, ATL vs SF ($7,500)

Drake London projects 3rd at the position with 18.1 DraftKings points at $7,500. The model gives him 9.1 targets on 27.1 routes. The salary works out to 2.41 projected points per $1,000, 5th of 28 at the position. Across 100,000 simulations London averaged 18.0 points with a simulated floor of 5.1 and a ceiling of 42.7, and he holds 15% of the simulated winning-lineup credit. Atlanta is a 2.5-point underdog at home against San Francisco, with an implied team total of 23.5 in a game totaled at 49.5.

Value: Matthew Golden, GB at DET ($6,000)

Matthew Golden projects for 16.5 DraftKings points at $6,000, which works out to 2.75 points per $1,000 of salary. That is the best rate of any player priced in the cheaper half of the 28 wide receivers the model projects for 9 or more points. The model gives him 7.9 targets on 32.8 routes. Across 100,000 simulations Golden averaged 16.5 points with a simulated floor of 3.8 and a ceiling of 41.4, and he holds 22% of the simulated winning-lineup credit. Green Bay is a 3.5-point underdog on the road against Detroit, with an implied team total of 26 in a game totaled at 55.5.
